items.title: Keyv and friends compromised in active Shai-Hulud supply chain attack
GitHub Hardens npm and Actions Defaults, Drawing Debate over Delays versus Signing
items.blurb: GitHub consolidated the npm and Actions changes it shipped from March to July 2026 against supply chain attacks, several of which alter defaults rather than add options.

items.title: npm Staged Publishing Available, Adding a Human Approval Step before Packages Go Live
items.blurb: npm has introduced staged publishing for Node.js, requiring maintainer approval before a version is installable. Versions are queued and must pass a two-factor authentication challenge for release.

Bitwarden CLI compromised
items.blurb: Bitwarden's CLI got hit by the Checkmarx supply-chain campaign, TypeScript 7.0 beta lands with the Go-rewritten compiler running ~10x faster than 6.0, and pgBackRest lost its maintainer of thirteen years leaving anyone running production…

items.title: From Tailnet to platform
items.blurb: Adam talks with Tailscale co-founder and Chief Strategy Officer David Carney about where Tailscale is headed next: TSIDP, TSNet, multiple tailnets, and Aperture.
